ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Holsters Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Holsters in IsoRim's 3D view: sheathed weapons sit on the 3D figures.
- Weapons show as IsoRim shows them in the hand: their 3D model, or their art made solid - Placed by your own Holsters settings, changes show at once - They follow the figure when it walks and turns
A figure has one place per weapon: sideways, height and tilt come from the South settings, front to back and lean from the East settings. North and West do not change the 3D place.
Needs IsoRim Waylith and Holsters.
让 Holsters 的收纳武器在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角里挂在 3D 人物身上。
- 武器和手持时一样显示：3D 模型，或把贴图做成立体 - 位置来自你自己的 Holsters 设置，改动立即生效 - 跟随人物行走和转身
3D 人物上每件武器只有一个位置：左右、高度和倾斜取南向设置，前后和前倾取东向设置。北向和西向不影响 3D 位置。
需要 IsoRim Waylith 和 Holsters。
